title: Had Claude drive Unity to stage this weapons test (Engines of Hate)
author: Failosipher
selftext: So this whole clip was Claude. I've got Claude hooked into my Unity editor through a bridge I built, so it can spawn units, move the camera, fire weapons and record the game straight from the engine at 30 fps with sound. I told it to remake an old test clip with the same positions, but with more bots and every missile actually firing. It found out the lasers and long-range missiles never fired on their own (they're manual-fire with a 40-85 m minimum range lol), so it scripted a timeline that fires them one after another, and it recorded this.
